questions.stem: What does the theory of evolution by natural selection state?

options.text: All organisms were created at the same time and have not changed
Organisms with advantageous characteristics are more likely to survive and reproduce, passing these traits on
Organisms can choose to develop beneficial features
All changes in organisms are caused by the environment alone

questions.explanation: The theory states that individuals with characteristics best suited to their environment are more likely to survive, reproduce, and pass on their genes. Over many generations, this leads to evolutionary change.
